texts.li: A great lord of {FACTION} is making a progress through the region, from town to town, with a retinue of fifty and a cart just for the banners. Every settlement on the road is expected to be seen at its best.\n\nThe road from {PLACE} passes within a morning's walk of the colony.

[faction:Outland_VathunNobles] The lord of {FACTION}'s forest court is traveling the country, as the Vathun's lords do every few summers, to be seen and to see. Servants walk ahead to sweep the road; poets walk behind to describe it.\n\nThe progress will pass near the colony on its way from {PLACE}.

[faction:Outland_Empire] A magistrate of the Eastborn Empire is touring the borderlands in a lacquered palanquin, with a long line of bearers, scribes and a tea-master. {FACTION} say the magistrate has held the post for three hundred years and has never once hurried.\n\nThe tour passes near the colony on its way from {PLACE}.

[factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.france|factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.hre|factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.poland|factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.russia] A count of {FACTION} is riding through the region with his household knights, his falcons and his confessor, holding court in every town that will have him.\n\nHis road from {PLACE} passes close to the colony.

[factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.byzantium|factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.turks|factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.iberia] A governor of {FACTION} is traveling the region with clerks, guards and a string of camels, counting everything and admiring nothing out loud.\n\nThe road from {PLACE} passes close to the colony.

[factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.mongols] A prince of {FACTION} is riding the region's roads with his guard, his hawks and more horses than men, visiting the towns that pay the khaganate its due.\n\nHis road from {PLACE} passes close to the colony.

summaries.li: {FACTION}'s lord will pass near the colony. Hosting the retinue for a night or sending a gift to meet it earns their goodwill; keeping to ourselves costs nothing.
[hosted] The colony hosted the lord's retinue for a night. {FACTION} will remember it.
[gift] The colony sent a gift to meet the progress on the road.

texts.li: A herald in {FACTION}'s colors rode up to the colony this morning, very upright, and asked {A_nameDef} whether the colony means to receive the progress. A night's rest for the retinue would be a fine thing, he said. A gift sent to meet them on the road would also be noticed.\n\nA proper night's hosting would cost the colony about {COUNT} silver in food, drink and fodder.

[faction:Outland_VathunNobles] A Vathun herald, horns freshly polished, presented himself to {A_nameDef} and asked, in the forest court's long way of asking, whether the colony would offer its lord a night under its roof. A gift on the road would also do, he allowed, for a settlement of no particular caste.\n\nA proper night's hosting would cost about {COUNT} silver.

[faction:Outland_Empire] An Eastborn scribe arrived ahead of the palanquin with a letter, a brush and a great deal of patience. The magistrate, the letter said, would honor the colony by resting there one night; or the colony might honor the magistrate with a gift on the road.\n\nA proper night's hosting would cost about {COUNT} silver.

li.label: Host the retinue for a night ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: The herald rides back with the colony's answer. Out come the brooms, and the yard is swept from wall to wall for the lord's coming.

li.label: Send a gift to meet them on the road
li.outcome: A steward of the progress came for the colony's gift, looked at it carefully, smiled carefully, and took it away to the lord.
li.deed: sent a gift to their lord's progress

li.label: Keep to ourselves
li.outcome: The herald was thanked for his trouble and given a cup of water. The progress will go by on the high road, banners and all, and the colony will watch it from the wall.

texts.li: The lord's retinue stayed the night at the colony. Someone taught the children a marching song, someone else lost a boot, and the lord's cook asked for the colony's bread recipe before they left.
[faction:Outland_VathunNobles] The Vathun lord's retinue stayed the night. The servants slept in the barn, the guards by the gate and the poets wherever they fell; the lord, it turned out, snores.
[faction:Outland_Empire] The Eastborn magistrate stayed the night and took tea with the colony at dawn: a long, quiet, beautiful hour that nobody quite knew how to end.
The lord's progress passed by on the high road this morning: banners, horses, a long dust cloud and a good deal of trumpeting. The colony watched it go by from the wall.
[gift] The progress passed by on the high road. As it went, a rider broke off and brought the colony a sealed letter of thanks from the lord.
{FACTION}'s lord has gone on toward {PLACE} and home. In the towns along the way, the story of the night at the colony has already grown in the telling, and the colony comes out of it well.

li.chronicle: The colony hosted a lord of {FACTION} on his progress.

texts.li: {FACTION}'s lord has gone on toward {PLACE}. The colony's gift is mentioned, now and then, in the right company.

li.chronicle: The colony sent a gift to a lord of {FACTION} on his progress.

texts.li: {FACTION}'s lord and his retinue have gone on their way, and the road past the colony is quiet again.

li.chronicle: A lord of {FACTION} passed by the colony on his progress.

texts.li: {FACTION} are holding a great gathering of their clans near {PLACE}. Warbands from every corner of their lands are on the roads, and every settlement within reach is watching its walls.

[faction:Outland_RedburnPact] The Redburn Pact is holding its moot near {PLACE}: every goblin chief, hobgoblin captain and orc warlord within a month's march, gathered to boast, feast and decide who to rob next. The roads are thick with their bands, all going the same way.

[factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.mongols] The khans of {FACTION} have called a great gathering on the grass near {PLACE}, to feast, race horses and choose where the riders go next. Every road for days around is full of horsemen, all going the same way.

summaries.li: {FACTION}'s bands are on the roads. An envoy may come asking for a token of respect: paying earns their goodwill, warning the neighbors earns theirs, and refusing costs only nerves.
[paid] The colony paid {FACTION}'s token of respect.
[warned] The colony sent word of the gathering to its neighbors.

texts.li: An envoy of {FACTION} rode up to the gate and asked {A_nameDef} for a token of respect for the gathering: {COUNT} silver, to show the colony knows whose roads these are this season.\n\nIt isn't a threat, the envoy said. He said it twice.

[faction:Outland_RedburnPact] A hobgoblin envoy in a coat of many stolen colors stood at the gate and asked {A_nameDef}, almost politely, for {COUNT} silver "for the moot's fire". The two orcs behind him said nothing at all, very loudly.

[factionmod:athelas.medievaltotalrim.mongols] A rider of {FACTION} reined in at the gate, unhurried, and asked {A_nameDef} for {COUNT} silver as the colony's gift to the gathering. He looked at the walls while he waited for the answer, and at the horses.

li.label: Pay the token ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: The envoy weighed the silver in one hand, nodded, and rode off without a backward glance. Word will go around the gathering that this colony knows its manners.
li.deed: paid a token to their gathering

li.label: Refuse, and send word to the neighbors
li.outcome: The envoy was refused, politely, and before he was out of sight {A_nameDef} had riders going to every friendly town within reach with word of how many bands were on the roads, and which way.
li.deed: warned the region of their gathering

li.label: Refuse, politely
li.outcome: The envoy heard the colony's answer, shrugged as if it made no difference to him, and rode off. Everyone on the wall watched him go.

texts.li: A band of {FACTION} went by on the road today, close enough to count. They looked the colony over and kept going.
[paid] Riders of {FACTION} went past the colony at midday. One of them raised a spear to the wall as they passed, which the lookout decided to take as a greeting.
A band of {FACTION} came along the road at a walk this afternoon, looking hard at the walls. The colony is keeping its gate shut and its lamps low, and the night watch has been doubled.
[warned] {FACTION}'s warriors went by slowly today, looking hard at the walls. Somewhere along the road the colony's warning is being cursed, and the colony knows it.
{FACTION}'s gathering near {PLACE} is over and the bands have gone home with their plans. The colony's token, it seems, was remembered: none of them came near.

li.chronicle: The colony paid a token to the gathering of {FACTION}.

texts.li: {FACTION}'s gathering near {PLACE} is over. The neighbors the colony warned had their walls manned when the bands went by, and they haven't forgotten who sent word.

li.chronicle: The colony warned its neighbors of the gathering of {FACTION}.

texts.li: {FACTION}'s gathering near {PLACE} is over, and the roads are emptying. Whatever they decided, they kept to themselves.
